sources.title: Centrally Sponsored Scheme of Post-Matric Scholarships to the Students Belonging to Scheduled Castes for Studies in India (2020-21 to 2025-26)
sources.issuing_body: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment, Government of India
sources.clause: Section 7 (Documents to be submitted with application form)
sources.notes: Requires application form, qualifying marksheet, caste certificate (if applicable), income certificate, and bank passbook/account details.

sources.title: NSP Operational Guidelines & Portal User Instructions
sources.issuing_body: National Scholarship Portal (NSP), Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY)
sources.notes: NSP upload guidelines instruct users to upload legible documents, but specific numeric OCR thresholds (0.60) are internal DocuReady engineering heuristics rather than primary statutory clauses.

sources.title: DBT Guidelines on Beneficiary Verification
sources.issuing_body: Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) Mission, Cabinet Secretariat
sources.notes: While DBT guidelines require beneficiary name and account routing data, the specific required field set is an application-level schema check.

sources.title: NSP Verification Manual & Operational Guidance
sources.notes: Portal scrutiny procedures require applicant names to match across certificates, but exact algorithmic similarity thresholds (e.g. token sort ratio >= 80) are internal linter heuristics.

sources.title: CBSE Examination Bye-Laws (Notification CBSE/Coord/2021)
sources.notes: Rule 69.2 governs date-of-birth records in CBSE secondary school certificates, which serve as standard age evidence across Indian government applications. Note: Governs certificate accuracy, not an overarching statutory scholarship decree.

sources.title: Centrally Sponsored Scheme of Post-Matric Scholarships to the Students Belonging to Scheduled Castes for Studies in India (2020-21 to 2025-26)
sources.issuing_body: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment, Government of India
sources.clause: Clause 3.1 (Conditions of Eligibility — Means Test Ceiling)
sources.notes: Explicitly sets the total annual family income ceiling at Rs. 2,50,000 for eligibility under the centrally sponsored scholarship scheme.

sources.title: NSP Guidelines for Institute Nodal Officers
sources.notes: Reconciliation between portal declaration and revenue certificate is an administrative verification check; no enacted clause specifies exact zero-tolerance text matching.

sources.title: State Revenue Miscellaneous Certificates Regulations & Executive Orders
sources.clause: State Executive Instructions on Income Certificate Duration
sources.notes: Revenue certificate validity varies by state and scheme. (Note: Odisha Miscellaneous Certificates Rules 2019 Rule 8 concerns cancellation, not duration; validity periods derive from separate executive notifications and vary across jurisdictions from 1 to 3 financial years). Marked unverified.

sources.title: e-District Mission Mode Project Technical Architecture
sources.notes: e-District §5.2 concerns identification of State Designated Agencies, not barcode verification APIs. Reference number string matching is an internal cross-document consistency check, not a statutory mandate.

sources.title: RBI Master Direction on Electronic Payment Systems — NEFT System Procedural Guidelines
sources.notes: Authoritatively defines the 11-character Indian Financial System Code (IFSC) format: 4 alpha characters, digit '0', and 6 alphanumeric branch characters.

sources.title: PFMS Operational Guidelines for DBT Account Validation
sources.notes: Matching between declared account numbers and passbook scans is an administrative pre-check heuristic to avoid PFMS validation rejections.

sources.title: State Scholarship Scheme Guidelines (e.g., e-Medhabruti / Odisha State Portal)
sources.notes: Domicile requirements are scheme- and state-specific. Validating state residence certificates against portal domicile declarations is an administrative eligibility check.

sources.title: Centrally Sponsored Scheme of Post-Matric Scholarships to the Students Belonging to Scheduled Castes for Studies in India (2020-21 to 2025-26)
sources.issuing_body: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment, Government of India
sources.clause: Section 4.2 (Eligibility & Academic Relaxation for Reserved Categories)
sources.notes: Recognizes qualifying examination passing requirements while enforcing statutory category relaxations for reserved category students.

sources.title: Aadhaar (Targeted Delivery of Financial and other Subsidies, Benefits and Services) Act 2016
sources.notes: Authoritative standard for 12-digit Indian national identity checksum.

sources.title: Income-tax Act 1961, Section 139A & Rule 114
sources.issuing_body: Central Board of Direct Taxes (CBDT), Ministry of Finance
